recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle group portrait of four men posing within the structural steel beams of a bridge, unified by a heavy sepia-orange monochromatic color grade and bold, wide-set sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and height
Monochromatic sepia filter unifying the subjects with the industrial background
Repetitive structural geometry of the bridge framing the human subjects
High-contrast lighting emphasizing muscle definition and fabric textures
coreInvariants: Industrial setting with visible rivets and steel beams
Wide-set, bold sans-serif display type at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the frame, varying in height and pose, filling the middle and lower two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central shirtless figure standing upright, flanked by figures in dynamic poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text at the top, moves down through the central figure, then outward to the flanking figures and the industrial details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with structural elements and figures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark chocolate brown/black (shadows and structural outlines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (typography and highlights on clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within a narrow hue range; high contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Increased letter-spacing (tracking) to span the full width of the composition
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for impact; secondary logo elements use custom pill-shaped enclosures.
graphicDevices: Pill-shaped logo enclosure with thick borders

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and heavy weight
Similar geometric qualities and modern feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photograph of four men in 90s streetwear posing inside the steel girders of a bridge. Apply a heavy monochromatic sepia-orange filter. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, wide geometric sans-serif text in white at the very top, with significant letter-spacing to span the width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic warm tones?
Is the camera angle sufficiently low?
Is the text at the top wide-spaced and bold?
Are the bridge rivets and steel textures visible?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
The exact logo in the bottom right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly horizontal and centered at the top.
Check that the sepia tone doesn't wash out the contrast in the shadows.
Verify the low-angle perspective makes the subjects look imposing.
Confirm the industrial bridge elements are sharp and detailed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial setting + Low-angle group shot + Monochromatic warm grade + Wide-tracked bold sans-serif header.
